changes.label: Playbook ✓
changes.current_text: Select companies with funded operating plans, reliable customers and manageable refinancing needs. Add resource exposure when actual consumption and project execution support it; add domestic exposure when payment and demand trends improve. Reduce risk if spending commitments grow while cash generation weakens. A change in labor demand would alter the domestic assessment through household income, payment behavior and the willingness to commit to major purchases.

changes.label: Attention Gap
changes.current_text: Reuters reports experts seeing deal pressure on Halliburton and Baker Hughes following SLB's deal-making. [[n0719]] The attention gap is the competitive effect of a changing service offering, not a claim that another acquisition has been agreed or that the shares are underowned.

changes.label: Playbook
changes.current_text: Choose the instrument that matches the thesis and limit exposure to a drawdown the portfolio can carry without forced selling. If the view concerns the underlying asset, a miner or a leveraged equity is a different risk budget. If the view concerns a business, require a plausible cash-flow case under less favorable prices. Add only when stabilization and observable demand support the narrative; reduce if financing pressure or operating costs undermine it. Product access, a familiar supply catalyst and investor conviction can all matter without guaranteeing the next price move. Let the position survive uncertainty rather than demanding that the event deliver immediate validation. Preserve a clear distinction between conviction and leverage.

changes.label: What Is Priced
changes.current_text: Australia's domestic-demand debate remains unsettled as ABC reports rising business failures and economic strains. [[n0073]] A weakening in labor demand would affect household income and payment capacity, while resilience would make the demand picture more constructive. Separate the state of a resource exporter from the financing position of domestic customers.
